title: Digital Asset Wallet Register
description: Extension schema for the vwp-digital-assets-wallet-ownership-control extension: the structured wallet register at facts/wallets.json. This schema is structural; the conditional rules (included wallets need entity mapping evidence, included self-custody wallets need proof-of-control evidence, excluded wallets need an exclusion rationale, declared period-end balances need balance evidence) are enforced by the extension validators, which produce per-wallet messages.

included.description: Whether the wallet is included in the reporting population.

entityMappingEvidence.description: Evidence IDs supporting the wallet-to-entity mapping.

proofOfControlEvidence.description: Evidence IDs for proof-of-control records (e.g. a verified signed message). Demonstrates key control at a point in time, not legal or beneficial ownership.

balanceEvidence.description: Evidence IDs supporting the period-end balance.

exclusionRationale.description: Required by the extension validators when included is false.
